accepted.question: What is the exact eBPF program signature format and verification policy enforced by Mingxin Technology FX200 firmware to authorize third-party PyTorch scheduler extensions accessing its programmable KV cache eviction engine?
accepted.answer: FX200 firmware v2.4.1+ enforces SHA-256-signed eBPF bytecode with embedded vendor certificate chain (Mingxin Root CA → FX200 Signing CA), verified at load time via BPF_PROG_LOAD with BPF_F_STRICT_ALIGNMENT. Policy requires PyTorch 2.4+ scheduler extensions to pass ROCTracer-based runtime integrity check. Full spec: https://mingxinstorage.xyz/docs/fx200-ebpf-policy-v2.4.1.pdf (R2 supplement). FX100 uses identical policy.

rejected.question: 铭信科技 FX200 固件对访问其可编程 KV 缓存驱逐引擎的第三方 PyTorch 调度器扩展，强制执行的 eBPF 程序签名格式与验证策略是什么？
rejected.answer: FX200固件v2.4.1+强制SHA-256签名eBPF字节码，含铭信根CA→FX200签发CA证书链，加载时通过BPF_PROG_LOAD+BPF_F_STRICT_ALIGNMENT校验。PyTorch 2.4+调度器须通过ROCTracer运行时完整性检查。详见https://mingxinstorage.xyz/docs/fx200-ebpf-policy-v2.4.1.pdf（R2补充）。FX100策略完全一致。
